svg.title: Repeat an archive check with a saved headless invocation
svg.desc: A fixed check.md prompt and prepared test copy feed a saved claude -p command. The agent smoke-tests the route before the full check. Each fresh headless session reads assigned inputs, uses permitted tools and saves its response, tool record and test report in a separate run folder. A corrected archive copy gets a new run; both records remain. Fresh context is distinct from configured file-access restrictions.
svg.text: Save the assignment and retain each run
Run in the test copy with configured access
After repairing the archive, rerun the check and retain both reports
